data.content: Andreas Pereira of Brazil's Palmeiras, left, is challenged by Guga of Brazil's Fluminense during the first leg of a Copa Libertadores semifinal soccer match in Rio de Janeiro, Wednesday, Oct. 14, 2026. Flaco Lopez of Brazil's Palmeiras celebrates after scoring his side's opening goal against Brazil's Fluminense during the first leg of a Copa Libertadores semifinal soccer match in Rio de Janeiro, Wednesday, Oct. 14, 2026. Flaco Lopez of Brazil's Palmeiras, right, celebrates with teammate Agustin Giay after scoring his side's opening goal against Brazil's Fluminense during the first leg of a Copa Libertadores semifinal soccer match in Rio de Janeiro, Wednesday, Oct. 14, 2026. A fan of Brazil's Fluminense waits for the start of the first leg of a Copa Libertadores semifinal soccer match between Brazil's Fluminense and Brazil's Palmeiras in Rio de Janeiro, Wednesday, Oct. 14, 2026. RIO DE JANEIRO (AP) — Striker José López and Marlon Freitas each scored a goal on Wednesday to lead Palmeiras to a 2-1 away victory over Fluminense in an all-Brazilian match during the first leg of the Copa Libertadores semifinals.
